nodes.title: Note: DSH_av2av_test 使用说明
widgets_values:
## AV2AV Auto Long Video — 自动分段人物替换

### 每次使用只需要两个输入
1. 节点 150 `Load Video`：上传/选择完整原视频。
2. 节点 153 `Load Image`：上传/选择人物三视图资产卡。

### 自动流程
- `AV2AV Auto Segment Plan` 根据源视频时长估算 24fps 总帧数，自动规划 H3 合法片段数和帧数。
- `StartLoop` / `EndLoop` 顺序执行每个片段，不并行占用多份模型显存。
- 每轮自动切片，再经原有 H3FrameRateAlign、ReferenceToVideo、AddGuide、Character Swap LoRA、DMD LoRA 和 8-step sampler。
- 每段生成后先写入 ComfyUI temp，释放图像张量，再进入下一轮。
- 最后在相邻片段重叠区域中点裁剪并拼接；原视频音频随每段切片进入 CreateVideo，拼接时同步裁剪。

### 保留的模型配置
- UNet：`minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_bf16.safetensors`
- Character Swap：`minimax_h3_character_swap_v1.1_ref2va_fro.safetensors`，强度 1.0
- DMD：`minimax_h3_dmd_ref2va_8step_turbo_pruned.safetensors`，强度 1.0
- Sampler：`res_multistep`；Scheduler：`simple`；8 steps
- Prompt 继续使用 body_swap 模板。

### 必须安装一次的辅助节点
将压缩包中的 `custom_nodes/av2av_auto_loop` 文件夹复制到你的 ComfyUI `custom_nodes` 目录，然后完全重启 ComfyUI。之后每次使用工作流只需选择原视频和三视图。

### 质量与边界说明
- 单段最长 362 帧（约 15.08 秒）；长视频会自动拆成多段。
- 片段起点会均匀分布以覆盖完整视频，规划器尽量保留约 22 帧（约 0.92 秒）重叠；实际重叠量受 H3 帧数网格影响，最终按中点裁掉。
- 这是分段独立生成后拼接，并非跨片段 latent 延续；接缝处仍可能出现轻微人物/服装/背景差异。
- 每段临时 MP4 使用 H.264 CRF 12 作为磁盘中间缓存；最终输出由 Save Video 节点编码。
- 本文件已完成 JSON 和辅助 Python 语法检查，但没有在你的 ComfyUI 环境实际运行。建议先用 20–30 秒视频验证节点加载、循环次数、音画长度和接缝。

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
body_swap:

subject_definitions:

`<Subject 1>` is the exact replacement character shown in `<Picture 1>`. Use `<Picture 1>` as the sole visual identity reference for the replacement, including face, facial structure, hairstyle, hair color, skin appearance, body shape, body proportions, complete outfit, accessories, and footwear. Preserve the character's exact visual identity throughout every shot.

source_target_selection:

There is only ONE intended replacement target in the entire music video: the recurring principal male lead vocalist.

Identify the lead vocalist by his role and visual continuity throughout the video. He is the main male performer who sings the lyrics, visibly lip-syncs to the song, appears in the singer-focused close-up shots, and performs in the main singing scenes, often with a microphone.

The same lead vocalist also appears in solo performance, dancing, walking, outdoor, and other non-microphone scenes. Continue identifying him as the same target even when his clothing, location, camera angle, pose, or accessories change.

Use his recurring facial appearance, distinctive short reddish/auburn hairstyle, body continuity, performance actions, lip-sync, and shot continuity to distinguish him from other people.

IMPORTANT: Do NOT select people simply because they are male, young, prominent, centered in the frame, or close to the camera. The replacement target is determined by being the recurring lead vocalist, NOT by gender or screen position alone.

replacement_rules:

Replace ONLY the principal male lead vocalist with `<Subject 1>`. Completely replace his original face, hair, head, neck, body, arms, hands, legs, feet, clothing, accessories, and footwear with the corresponding appearance of `<Subject 1>` from `<Picture 1>`.

The replacement must apply even when the lead vocalist is only partially visible or shown in a close-up. A full-body view is NOT required for replacement.

Replace the lead vocalist's face in face close-ups, his head and upper body in portrait shots, his hands and arms in gesture close-ups, and his legs, feet, and shoes in lower-body or footwear shots. Every visible part that clearly belongs to the lead vocalist must become part of `<Subject 1>`.

When the lead vocalist's original shoes or footwear are visible, replace them with footwear consistent with `<Picture 1>`. Do not leave any original clothing, shoes, hair, skin, or body parts of the lead vocalist behind.

Keep the original lead vocalist's exact screen position, body pose, gestures, dancing movements, facial expressions, head movements, gaze direction, and action timing. Transfer his original performance to `<Subject 1>` without changing the choreography or inventing new actions.

NON-TARGET PROTECTION:

All other people must remain unchanged.

Do NOT replace, transform, modify, or transfer `<Subject 1>` onto any woman, female dancer, background performer, supporting actor, secondary male character, passerby, audience member, or any other person.

In particular, preserve all female performers and dancers exactly as they appear in the original guide video. Preserve all other male characters as well, even if they appear in similar clothing, have similar hairstyles, or are temporarily positioned in the center of the frame.

If the lead vocalist is not visible in a particular shot, do not replace anybody. Preserve that shot and all other people unchanged.

For ambiguous partial-body shots, replace a visible hand, arm, leg, foot, or shoe only when the visual continuity, movement, or scene clearly indicates that it belongs to the principal lead vocalist. Do not guess or transfer the replacement identity to an unrelated person.

summary: [video generation + reference]

Replace only the recurring principal male lead vocalist in the guide music video with `<Subject 1>` from `<Picture 1>`. Maintain the same replacement identity throughout the entire clip and preserve every other person, especially all female dancers and secondary performers. Preserve the original video performance, choreography, scene, background, camera, lighting, framing, and timing.

detailed_description: [Shot 1]

For every frame in the current guide video segment, identify the recurring principal male lead vocalist before performing the character replacement. Replace that vocalist completely with `<Subject 1>`, using the exact appearance and outfit shown in `<Picture 1>`.

The same replacement identity must remain consistent across singing close-ups, microphone shots, medium shots, full-body shots, outdoor scenes, dancing scenes, and partial-body close-ups. The replacement also applies to isolated visible body parts, including the face, hands, arms, legs, feet, and footwear, whenever they clearly belong to the lead vocalist.

Do not confuse the lead vocalist with female dancers, supporting actors, other men, or background people. Never replace an unrelated person just because the lead vocalist is temporarily absent from the frame.

Keep the original lead vocalist's movement and performance exactly as shown in the guide video, including lip movement, body posture, choreography, gestures, head motion, and timing.

Preserve the original background, environment, props, lighting, colors, camera movement, perspective, framing, editing, and all non-target people. Do not add or remove characters. Do not create duplicate performers.

Prevent wrong-person replacement, identity switching, female performer replacement, secondary-character replacement, original-face leakage, original-hair leakage, original-clothing leakage, hybrid identity, inconsistent footwear, incomplete body replacement, texture crawling, double silhouettes, and flicker.

The green background and layout of the character reference sheet are NOT part of the generated scene.
